newsitem.title: UK: Energy executives agree double-pay bonuses - paper.
newsitem.headline: Energy executives agree double-pay bonuses - paper.

text.p: Executives at Energy Group, a division of the Anglo-American conglomerate Hanson Plc, have implemented bonus schemes that could more than double their salaries, The Times newspaper reported.
Energy Group owns Eastern, Britain's fourth largest electricity generator, and is scheduled to be spun off from Hanson on February 24.

John Devaney, who will earn 350,000 pounds as chief executive of Eastern Group, could receive an additional bonus of 437,500 pounds in three years time, assuming his current salary stays the same, The Times reported.
Energy said Tuesday it is mulling acquisitions and has already started talks with a U.S. power marketing company.
